args.title: Fix weekly scheduled exports skipping their first run
args.body:
File: src/export/scheduler.ts

In `nextRunAt`, the "weekly" branch unconditionally adds 7 days after setting the hour to `RUN_HOUR_UTC`, unlike the "daily" branch which only advances a day if the computed time has already passed (`if (next <= from) ...`). This means that when a weekly schedule is created earlier in the day than `RUN_HOUR_UTC` (e.g. 05:40 UTC with a 06:00 UTC run hour), the still-upcoming run for that same day is skipped and the schedule's first send is pushed a full week later, matching the reported behavior (export created Monday 6 Oct 05:40 UTC, first email arrived Monday 13 Oct instead of the same day).

Proposed fix: make the weekly case conditional like the daily one — only add 7 days when `next <= from`; otherwise leave `next` as the computed same-day run time. This ensures a weekly schedule created before `RUN_HOUR_UTC` fires on its intended first day instead of silently skipping it.
